note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'gets the ball' (the first touch) to 'goal' (the ball crossing the line): keep the pause before 'goal!'. Chapter 3 whips to the bench on 'On the bench'.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Compostela, 1996. Ronaldo gets the ball near halfway. A trip, a shirt pull, but he stays on his feet! He powers between two players, into the box... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. A trip: arms out for balance! A shirt pull: he leans forward and shrugs it off. Then big, powerful strides.

chapters.label: The coach
chapters.text: Then a low shot, past the keeper! On the bench, coach Bobby Robson held his head in disbelief.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stay strong and balanced when someone pushes you, and keep the ball close as you run.
